headline: PRIN PROP shares plunge 100.00% on open gap as AGM resolution is disapproved
market_take: The property sector dominated today with strong moves and unusual volume, highlighted by AWC's +11.94% rally and PRIN's 100% price gap. Food stocks showed mixed activity, from AQUA's -9.09% open gap to MADAME's 27.4% five‑day gain. PF&REITs posted modest gains but saw notable volume spikes, while the consumer sector faced pressure from PLE's -22.22% intraday drop. Several high‑impact filings, including TTCL's clarification and ITC's connected‑transaction opinion, add to the market narrative.
